toolchain.golden_command:
DIALECTS_ROOT=$(pwd)
GOLDEN_WORKDIR=$(mktemp -d)
export ROOTFORM_HOME="$GOLDEN_WORKDIR/home"
"$ROOTFORM_BIN" install dialects "$DIALECTS_ROOT"
for golden in $(rg --files fixtures -g architecture.golden | sort); do
  relative=${golden%/architecture.golden}
  fixture="$GOLDEN_WORKDIR/$relative"
  mkdir -p "$fixture/.rootform/dialects"
  cp "$relative"/* "$fixture/"
  for dialect in $(bun -e 'for (const d of require("./dialects.json").dialects) console.log(d.name)'); do
    cp -R "$dialect" "$fixture/.rootform/dialects/$dialect"
  done
  "$ROOTFORM_BIN" build "$fixture" --offline --no-input > "$fixture/generated.json" || exit 1
  { cat "$fixture/generated.json"; printf '\n'; } > "$golden"
done
